'''Junior officers''' were low ranking [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in military forces such as the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. A common first assignment for junior officers in the Imperial Navy was the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderflare]]'' as the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was assigned to patrol duties within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="CCG-Thunderflare">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=''Thunderflare''}}</ref>
